# Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

**Embedded emissions = 25,300.00 tCO2e**

## Input Check

| Required input | Provided | In table? |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | ✅ Yes |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Yes, listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 10,000 t | ✅ Yes |

All required inputs are present, so no estimation is needed.

## Factor Selection

The factor is selected by both CN code and country: CN 7201 + India gives a **default SEE of 2.53 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 10,000 t
= **25,300.00 tCO2e**
